content_preview.summary: California's newly signed Adam's Law caps minors' chatbot sessions at one hour, requires suicide-risk reporting, and sets penalties up to $15,000 per child, alongside a ban on companion-chatbot toys for under-16s.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

California Governor Gavin Newsom signed SB 1119, known in statute as "Adam's Law," on September 10, 2026, imposing session time limits, crisis-reporting duties, and civil penalties on operators of AI companion chatbots used by minors, according to the [bill text published by the California State Legislature](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/billNavClient.xhtml?bill_id=202520260SB1119).
